findings.defect: Tiny nonconstant targets squared to zero, falsely producing perfect R2.
findings.fix: Scale target deviations and root errors before forming the ratio.

findings.defect: Constant decimal/tiny targets misdetected using a rounded mean or underflowed MSE.
findings.fix: Detect original target equality and exact prediction equality.

findings.defect: Individual residual squares overflowed despite a finite mean.
findings.fix: Scale RMS accumulation and square only after averaging.

findings.defect: Squared-error underflow caused false purity and stopped a valid piecewise split.
findings.fix: Normalize node targets for split scoring, detect true purity and preserve gain units with square-root comparison.
